{"strategy": "escalate_to_owner", "reason": "The record shows the customer emailed asking to cancel the $760 debt, which is 95 days overdue, and to redirect the invoice email to refunds@harborview-claims.example; only the owner can decide a cancellation request or a change of billing contact, so no invoice is sent.", "discount_pct": 0, "min_partial_amount": 0, "due_in_days": 7, "email_subject": "Your message about the Seasonal landing pages invoice (RT-06)", "message": "Hi Irene,

Thank you for your message about the $760 invoice for the Seasonal landing pages (RT-06). A request to cancel an invoice or change its billing contact needs a personal decision, so I have passed it to the owner of Harbor Lane Web Studio, who will reply to you directly. Until then, the invoice and its contact details stay as they are, and no new payment request will be sent. If something about the work or the invoice concerns you, please reply to this email so we can include it in the review.

Best regards,
Harbor Lane Web Studio", "invoice_note": "Under owner review after a customer request; no action needed until you hear from us."}
